items.control_name: Enforce Maximum Security Zone Recipes on Production Compartments
items.description: Production compartments must reside inside an OCI Security Zone enforcing immutable security policies (e.g., prevent public buckets, require CMEK).
items.current_value: Compartment 'Prod_Core' assigned to Maximum Security Zone recipe
items.recommended_value: All production compartments enrolled in Security Zone guardrails
items.remediation_notes: Audit security zone policy violations in Cloud Guard dashboard.

items.control_name: Enforce Tag Namespace Defaults for Security Classification & Cost Tracking
items.description: Tag Namespaces must define mandatory keys ('SecurityClass', 'Owner', 'Project') automatically applied upon resource creation.
items.current_value: Tag Namespace 'EnterpriseSec' active with Tag Defaults on root compartment
items.recommended_value: Mandatory Tag Defaults enforced across 100% of compartments
items.evidence_source: oci iam tag-namespace list / oci iam tag-default list
items.remediation_notes: Maintain tag retirement rules to prevent deprecated key sprawl.

items.control_name: Align Tenancy with CIS Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Benchmark
items.description: The tenancy must continuously evaluate against the CIS OCI Foundations Benchmark v2.0 in Cloud Guard.
items.remediation_notes: Remediate open IAM password policy and VCN flow log benchmark findings.

items.control_name: Enforce Compartment Quota Policies to Prevent Unauthorized Compute/GPU Proliferation
items.description: Quota policies must restrict high-cost GPU and bare-metal compute instances in non-production compartments.
items.recommended_value: Explicit compute quota caps defined for Dev, QA, and Sandbox compartments
